The team
Headshot

Cristina Mancini
Founder & CEO

Cristina Mancini has spent more than two decades expanding who gets to build, lead, and shape the future.

As founder and CEO of Beyond Code Collective and CEO of Black Girls CODE, she leads two organizations united by one mission: expanding who gets to build the technology that will define our future.

As Chief Engagement Officer at Salesforce.org and SVP of Salesforce Studios, she built the Make Change franchise with Tribeca and Sundance. During 12 years at 20th Century Fox she rose to EVP of Franchise Development across a $10B+ portfolio.

Recognized by the Ebony Power 100 and the San Francisco Business Times. Featured in Essence, Fast Company, Mashable, and TechCrunch.

Because when we ask who is coding our future, the answer should be all of us.

Fonz Leadership bio. Swap the headshot for the official file before presenting.

Mica Le John
Executive Director

Mica Le John is a nonprofit executive, strategist, and entrepreneur who has spent nearly two decades building the partnerships, communities, and career pathways that help people thrive.

As Executive Director of Beyond Code Collective, she leads an organization bridging the gap between inspiration, training, and employment in technology.

Before launching Beyond Code Collective, Mica helped lead the transformation of Black Girls Code, serving as Chief of Staff before becoming VP of Strategic Partnerships and Innovation.

She is the co-founder of Idoru, a creative technology company, and has advised venture-backed startups and mission-driven organizations across technology, media, and wellness.

Fonz Morris
Head of Product

Fonz Morris leads product for Beyond Code Collective and Black Girls Code, where he builds the platforms, programs, and digital experiences that connect communities to technology education.

A Brooklyn-born, self-taught designer, Fonz spent five years at Netflix as Lead Product Designer for Global Conversion, overseeing conversion systems for more than 300 million subscribers across 190 countries.

Before Netflix, he was Growth Design Lead at Coursera, where he helped scale the platform to 20 million learners.

Named one of Business Insider's Most Innovative Designers, Fonz is a three-time founder, an investor, and a keynote speaker with more than 50 talks across four continents.

Jihan Johnston-McGlotten
Managing Director

Jihan Johnston-McGlotten has spent her career reimagining how education, technology, and culture can come together to create opportunity for the next generation.

As Managing Director of Beyond Code Collective, she leads the organization's strategy, operations, and program delivery.

A nationally recognized leader in educational innovation, Jihan co-founded BeatBotics and has led global educational esports initiatives with NASEF, and partnered with Microsoft to expand technology adoption.

She holds a Master of Education in Educational Leadership, graduating cum laude from Concordia University Portland.

BCC · Rancho Cordova17
The team
Ramon Clemente
Head of Beyond the Game

Ramon Clemente is proving that excellence doesn't end when a career does, it evolves.

As Head of Beyond the Game, Ramon leads an AI-first workforce development program helping former athletes transition from professional sports into careers in technology and cybersecurity.

After a 17-year professional basketball career, he joined Beyond Code Collective's inaugural cohort, earned his CompTIA certification, and built his first AI agent before stepping into leadership.

He is also the founder of Clemente's Cafe and PUSH 100MPH Fitness. Ramon earned his degree in Criminal Justice from Wichita State, where he played Division I basketball.
